question:
Choose the option which is antonym of (opposite of) the word "frugal" in the sentence given below:

Her generous donation to the charity made a significant impact on the lives of those in need.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"frugal"** means being economical in the use of resources; sparing or thrifty. (मितव्ययी)

 
 
• **Example:** He lived a** frugal** life, saving most of his earnings and spending very little.
 
 
 
• **"Generous"** refers to someone who is willing to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदार)
 
 
• **Example:** She was very **generous **with her time, always willing to help others in need.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'frugal'** is **'generous'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Impact** (प्रभाव): The action of one object coming forcibly into contact with another; a marked effect or influence.

 
 
• **Example:** The new policy had a significant** impact **on the company's growth.
 
 
 
• **Charity** (दान): The voluntary giving of help, typically in the form of money, to those in need.
 
 
• **Example:** She regularly donates to various** charities** to help those less fortunate.
 
 
 
• **Significant** (महत्वपूर्ण): Sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention; noteworthy.
 
 
• **Example:** The discovery was **significant** for the field of medical research.
